explication: Apache Beam is a multi-language model and runtime for defining batch and streaming data-parallel pipelines and executing them on distributed backends. The central workflow is: a user builds a pipeline from transforms and collections with an SDK, the SDK represents it for a selected runner, and the runner executes it; results and metrics are then exposed to the caller. The repository also includes portable execution support, file and cloud I/O, and learning materials. Relationships beyond the README’s documented workflow are limited to those visible in sampled source or the source index.
